Name: Giant Floating Penis (Horse Replacement)
Author: Girafarig
Description:
A silly mod that I created five years ago but never uploaded. Rediscovered it recently and decided better late than never! Updated it a tad and its ready for 1.6. 

Turns the horse into a giant floating penis (duh).

Comes in four variations: Light, Tan, Deep, and Qi Blue.

This mod was built using Content Patcher, so you'll need that.

I think thats all of it! Let me know any questions, concerns, improvements, everything!
